title: lookup_business_bot records the query before the sends; a failed second/third send leaves it unresolved for the same text
trigger: Type a bot username while mine/global send fails
effect: lookup.query is set, Exact sent, `?` returns on Mine; typing the same text again returns early at line 179, so mine/global stay None (loading) until the text changes
fix: Set lookup.query only after all three parts are sent, or mark failed parts.

title: admin_followups are removed only when a real envelope answers; swept or settled requests keep them
trigger: A basic group upgrade or history toggle request is swept (stale TTL) or settled by logout while a followup is queued.
effect: The followup stays in groups.admin_followups forever and the chained step (link, topics, history) never runs and no error note appears.
fix: Drop and fail followups in settle_lost_request.

title: A second unrestrict-boost-count change while one is in flight is dropped with Ok(None)
trigger: Change the unrestrict boost count twice quickly
effect: The second value is lost without a message; the field shows the later value while the server has the first
fix: Queue the latest value and send it when the first answers, or disable the control while pending.

title: NewChatState::creations entries are never removed
trigger: Create groups/channels repeatedly in one session
effect: grep finds no remove/retain/clear on creations: every create request stays with its outcome (and any unused photo path) until the account session ends
fix: Remove the entry when the dialog leaves the Creating stage (Farewell) or when the outcome is consumed

title: add_chat_welcome_message dedupes by purpose across all chats, with no feedback
trigger: Start adding a welcome message in chat A, add one in chat B before A answers
effect: The second add returns Ok(None) silently; the user's text is not sent and no error shows (edit/delete dedupe per chat)
fix: Use has_purpose_for_chat like edit/delete, and surface the refusal

title: Revoked-link fetches use my_user_id.unwrap_or(0) as creator
trigger: Open revoked links before getMe has answered
effect: Request is sent for creator 0 and the cached Loaded list is for the wrong creator or errors
fix: Refuse (Ok(None)) until my_user_id is known

title: A permissions save is not atomic: permissions may be sent, then slow mode or boosts fail
trigger: Save permissions plus slow mode where the second send fails.
effect: Err is returned after setChatPermissions was already sent (and applied optimistically); the box shows a failure but part of the save is live.
fix: Return a per-part outcome and tell the user which parts applied.

title: maybe_download_profile_thumbs drops the rest of the queue on the first download error
trigger: One thumbnail download_file returns Err.
effect: take_profile_thumbs already emptied the queue; the ? returns early so remaining thumbnails are not asked until the tab is reopened.
fix: Ignore the per-file error (continue) or requeue the rest.

title: FilterDraft::open drops stored administrators that are no longer in the admin list and can open with none ticked
trigger: Filter Recent actions by one admin, remove that admin's rights, reopen the filter box.
effect: The stored filter has stored_admins=[X] but all_admins excludes X, so draft.admins is empty: 'All admins' and every admin box show unticked and Save is disabled until the user ticks something, while the log still filters by X.
fix: Keep stored ids in the draft even when they are not in the current list, or treat an empty intersection as 'all admins'.

title: Chat-wide join-request pages: a late older answer applies once join_request_latest was removed
trigger: Search join requests (R1 'a'), then 'ab' (R2); R2 answers (latest removed), then R1 answers
effect: is_none_or accepts R1, replacing the list with the older query's results
fix: Keep the latest id until a new query replaces it, or reject ids lower than the last applied one.

title: Admin list answer applied after a membership update dropped the cache
trigger: Open the admin list; getChatAdministrators in flight; updateChatMember arrives (removes admin_lists entry); answer lands
effect: The pre-change list is stored as Loaded and shown until the next membership change
fix: Drop in-flight admin list requests in UpdateChatMember, or tag the fetch with a revision.

title: New join request bumps total_count while a search filter hides it
trigger: Search join requests for 'x' (join_request_queries non-empty); a request from someone else arrives
effect: The request is not inserted but total_count is incremented, so the list count exceeds the shown rows
fix: Bump the total only when the request is inserted or matches the query.

title: Invite-link, revoked-link and link-count list errors are not matched to the request that failed
trigger: Open Invite Links, then create/revoke a link so the list is refetched twice quickly; the older request errors after the newer answered.
effect: The older error inserts Failed over the newer Loaded list (no request id compare), so the panel shows an error with good data hidden.
fix: Store the latest request id with each Fetch (as join_request_latest and InviteLinkMembersState::request do) and apply an error only when it matches.

title: GetMoreChatJoinRequests error clears join_request_latest without comparing the request id
trigger: Load more join requests (request A in flight), type a search (request B becomes latest), then A errors.
effect: join_request_latest is removed although B is the newest; B is then accepted only by the is_none_or fallback, and any other older answer would also land. The GetChatJoinRequests arm compares ids; this arm does not.
fix: Remove the entry only when it equals pending.id, as the GetChatJoinRequests arm does.

title: NewChatState::creations entries are never removed
trigger: Create several groups/channels in one session.
effect: Every create request id keeps its NewChatCreation (photo, outcome, flags) for the life of the session; no remover exists outside tests.
fix: Remove the creation when the dialog's stage leaves Creating (or when the outcome is consumed).

title: Bot lookup results shown for a stale query while the new text is debounced
trigger: Chat Automation, type a username, wait for results, then keep typing.
effect: business_found_bots checks only that lookup.query is non-empty, not that it equals the typed text; for up to 400 ms (and the request round trip) the old query's bots are listed as hits for the new text, with live Add buttons, and the leave-confirm ('No bot added') is decided on them.
fix: Compare parse_username_query(text) with lookup.query; treat a mismatch as Found::Loading.

title: Saving hours silently replaces the saved time zone with the closest one when the saved id is missing from TDLib's list
trigger: Hours were saved with a zone id absent from getTimeZones; open Business Hours, change only a weekday, leave.
effect: business_zone() falls back to closest_time_zone and save_business_hours prefers it over draft.time_zone_id, so wanted != base on zone alone and a different zone is sent.
fix: Prefer the draft's saved id; use the closest zone only for a draft that had no zone.

title: Cancel on the Create visibility box is live while createCommunity is in flight
trigger: Press Create (button busy), then Cancel: box returns to the identity box; the Created outcome arrives
effect: Created closes the box only when it is still CreateVisibility, so the identity box stays over the finished community and a second Next/Create sends another createCommunity for a chat already in a community (an error toast)
fix: Disable Cancel while the CreateCommunity request is in flight, or let the outcome close any Create* box for that chat.

title: Topic menu builds the Ban/Unban item from a banned flag read before the member fetch answers
trigger: As a monoforum admin, open the header menu of a person who is already banned and whose ban status was not yet loaded.
effect: The menu closure captures banned (false while direct_member_banned is unknown) at render time; the fetch started by the same click answers after the menu was built, so it offers Ban for a banned person. Ban then asks to confirm and re-bans.
fix: Render the ban item as Fetch-state: disabled 'checking' until the member status is Ready, then Ban or Unban.

title: A chat window showing a group that was upgraded stays on the dead group when the main window handle is gone
trigger: Open a basic group in a chat window, close or hide the main window so main_window.handle is None, then upgrade the group (from another device or the chat window's box).
effect: move_upgraded_chat_window returns early; the chat window keeps the deactivated basic group, the upgrade event has already been taken by take_chat_upgrades.
fix: Open the replacement window from any live window handle, or retarget the chat window's chat in place.

title: Upgrade to supergroup confirm closes the box before the request is answered
trigger: Group Settings > Upgrade > confirm while the driver refuses the request (Err) or returns None.
effect: group_settings_action runs, then close_group_settings_dialog runs regardless; a failure only produces a toast and the user must reopen the box to try again.
fix: Make the upgrade a request stage (Confirm, Sending, Failed(reason)) that closes on the answer or on the pump_chat_upgrades event.

title: A box derived as Saved is never removed and can reopen as Failed
trigger: Save succeeds (box closes); later another Manage action (upgrade, sign/translate toggle) records a Settings error for the same chat in info_edit_errors
effect: admin.group_edit_box still holds the old box with saving=Some(done ids); state() flips Saved -> Failed, group_edit_box() returns it again and the host reopens the Edit box with a stale reason
fix: Drop admin.group_edit_box (via close_group_edit_box) when the state becomes Saved, not just hide it.

title: Add Members clears the picked contacts even when the add could not be sent
trigger: Member dialog, tick contacts, press Add while add_chat_members returns Err.
effect: std::mem::take(add_selected) runs before the send; on Err an error note shows and the user's picks are lost (the box is not closed).
fix: Take the selection only after Ok, or restore it on Err.

title: Unban/kick refetch the member page right after sending, before the change applies
trigger: Unban a member in the Banned tab (or remove one from Add exception)
effect: refresh_supergroup_members clears the cache and asks again immediately; the page can come back with the member still there and nothing refetches after the status change lands
fix: Refetch on the answer to the set-status request (match by request id).

title: Permissions Save sends the permissions then fails on slow mode and restores the box
trigger: Change permissions and slow mode, Save when set_chat_slow_mode_delay returns Err
effect: Permissions were already sent but the box is restored and an error toast says it failed; Save again compares against the new state
fix: Report which parts were sent and close/restore per part.

title: Share link sets a session-wide share target from a chat window profile
trigger: Right-click the group link in a profile modal and choose Share.
effect: self.share.link_text is session-wide (main window state); the chooser opens in the window of the last press, not necessarily the window that asked.
fix: Use the Asker seam to name the window for the share box.

title: Opening an info panel with a failed fetch still leaves the target set
trigger: Open a user or group panel while the fetch request returns Err.
effect: Target is already set in the driver and the error note is shown; the panel draws empty with no retry path other than closing and reopening.
fix: Model the panel as Fetch<T> so the failure is drawn with a Retry.

title: Choosing Public at the links limit leaves draft.public set while the box shows Private
trigger: Open Type box at the public links limit, click Public (limit box opens), dismiss it.
effect: draft.public is true but public_blocked hides it; if a link is freed later the box flips to Public with a link check the user did not choose. Save handles blocked correctly.
fix: Do not store the blocked choice; keep draft.public false until the limit clears.

title: Apply-to-invite-links alert answer is not matched to the type box that asked
trigger: Press Save in the Type box with join-approval changed, leave the alert open, close the Edit box (chat removed or window closed), open another group's Type box, then answer the alert.
effect: finish_group_type_box(Some(..)) applies to whatever type box is open now, not the chat that asked.
fix: Carry (chat_id, box token) in the alert and compare before finishing.

title: Show/hide username alert answer is not matched to the box that asked
trigger: Click a username, leave the alert open, close the Edit box and reopen it, answer the alert.
effect: toggle_group_type_username sends for the captured chat/name even if the box is no longer for that chat or the username list changed.
fix: Check that the Type box for chat_id is still open before sending.

title: New community box closes and says 'created' when the request is only sent
trigger: Create community with a chat TDLib then refuses (createCommunity error).
effect: submit_create_community_dialog takes the dialog on Ok(Some(_)) and shows the silent 'Community created' note; the refusal arrives later through Session::community_error and the typed name and picked chat are gone.
fix: Keep the dialog as Creating(RequestId) until updateCommunity or the error answer for that request.

title: Selecting a topic flushes the draft and forgets scroll before the select can fail
trigger: Click a topic row while select_topic returns Err.
effect: The leaving draft is flushed and the target topic's scroll memory forgotten, then an error note shows and the old view stays; draft restore runs for a view that did not change.
fix: Do the flush/forget after select_topic returns Ok.

title: Retry in the welcome dialog rebuilds the dialog and drops typed text
trigger: Type a new welcome message, load fails, press Retry.
effect: open_welcome_dialog replaces the whole WelcomeDialog (new inputs), so the typed text and an open edit are lost.
fix: Retry should only re-request load_chat_welcome_messages for the open dialog.

title: toggle_link_requests ignores the Err of open_link_join_requests
trigger: Tap Requests on a link while the driver refuses
effect: Nothing opens and no note
fix: Set an error note on Err

title: revoked_open toggled before fetch; fetch Err ignored
trigger: Toggle Revoked links while the driver refuses the fetch
effect: Shows loading row forever (fetch map has no entry)
fix: Open state and Fetch<T> as one enum

title: focus_custom is taken during dialog build, not when the field is drawn
trigger: Open Custom limit; build runs but content closure never runs before a rebuild
effect: Number field is not focused
fix: Focus on first paint of the field entity

title: A finished plain group leaves admin.create_chat_dialog Some; 'closed' is only derived from the session's outcome
trigger: File > New Group, name it, pick members, Create. The session reports Created, so NewChatStep::Done hides the box.
effect: The kit box closes but NewChatDialog (three input entities, stage Creating) stays in admin.create_chat_dialog until the next open, and the NewChatCreation row stays in session.groups.new_chats.creations for the life of the session; nothing clears either.
fix: Make the dialog an Option that the Done arm takes (close_new_chat on Done, as drain_new_community_chat does) and remove the creation row when its outcome is consumed.

title: Editing the link clears Type.saving while the save request is still out
trigger: Type step: Save with a link, then type another character before TDLib answers.
effect: new_chat_link_edited sets saving = None, so the view is no longer busy and Save is enabled again with the first request still pending; a second Save sends another, and the late failure of the first cannot be told from the second.
fix: Keep the in-flight request id in the stage and separate 'refusal shown' from 'request in flight' (Type { chat, save: Idle | Saving(req) | Refused }).

title: Subscribers step finishes as if Add worked when addChatMembers failed or there is no client
trigger: New Channel, pick subscribers, press Add while the driver refuses (no rights, no client).
effect: A note says the add failed, but finish_new_chat clears create_chat_dialog and opens the chat in the same call: the selection is lost and the box is gone, so the user cannot retry from it.
fix: Move to a Subscribers { adding: Fetch } stage and finish only on the answer; keep the box on error.

title: Statistics keep the colors of the theme they were fetched in
trigger: Open statistics in light theme, switch to dark; the cached Loaded result is kept and getChatStatistics(is_dark) is not resent.
effect: Chart colors do not follow the theme until the user presses Refresh.
fix: Store the is_dark the result was fetched for in the Loaded variant and refetch when it differs.

title: Failed poll votes graph shows nothing and is never retried
trigger: Open message statistics of a poll when getStatisticalGraph for poll votes fails (PollStatsFetch::Failed).
effect: Poll section silently absent ('_ => {}').
fix: Draw the error and a retry like the other pages.
